novos.a59: «KAPITAL-Т» - is one of the largest distribution companies in the Republic of Tajikistan, engaged in wholesale trade and the distribution of food products, perfumes and cosmetics, hygiene products, and more. Since 2000, LLC “KAPITAL-T” has been developing dynamically — new partnerships have been established, the number of clients has been growing, the company’s material and technical base has been improving, and its software systems have been enhanced. The company continuously works to expand its sales geography in order to cover remote and hard-to-reach regions of the country. The organizational structure is evolving, the wholesale and retail sales directions are actively developing, and operations within the sales and logistics departments are being optimized.The quality of distribution continues to improve, which is confirmed by the company’s leading position in the market.
